SWE Atlas

benchmark.swe-atlas

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

Distinct SWE-Atlas primary paper work or named benchmark family. Complete primary-text and declared selected-visual/creator-release scopes were actually read independently, and all16 bounded assertions carry exact author, source-verifier and adversarial AI source-content reviews. Paper v1, current v1.1 repository and the modified AA QnA release remain distinct. AA cards, task components and release variants do not add independent families. No experiment reproduction, independent upstream rights clearance, withheld proprietary manual review or unsubstantiated supplier contribution is implied. Core inventory eligibility/disposition freeze remains separate.
